candidate.semantics: Keep the strongest ceil(3K/4) quality-ranked aim bases, then fill the unchanged remaining base slots from the first 2K ranks by greedily maximizing minimum distance over exact current-axis outcomes and the existing uncharged outgoing-axis projection.
candidate.low_k_exact: K <= 3 retains the production quality prefix exactly

interpretation: The arm was active and fixed-count, but geometric state distance is not a better base-selection objective than the production quality rank. Early positive looks did not reproduce. The replacement bases produced fewer admitted proposals, worse exact-pool placement, a slower first terminal, fewer distinct terminal tracks, a negative seven-of-eight budget pattern above 150k, and one net validity loss. Higher internal repair gain is an association after the changed initial and repair paths; it did not translate into authored score. Do not compose this selector with reduced random breadth and do not tune the reserved fraction.

production.decision: restore the singular production top-K quality prefix
production.source_equivalence: After closure, optimizer/aim.ts, optimizer/node.ts, and arc_control_registry.test.ts are byte-identical to parent commit 1716247.

next_family: Do not remove random-prefix work on the strength of state-space diversity. A future nCand intervention needs a direct redundancy or marginal-value certificate tied to the production quality objective, or must improve the proposal generator before shortening the independent random tail. A future later-anchor repair arm must use a causal redundancy/failure trigger and protect the first high-value repair; fixed depth, reserve, cost-density, and headroom variants are already closed.
